opening.quote: Good afternoon, thank you for calling Tidewell Home, Bram speaking. How can I help you?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Done, I've updated the account to eva.smit@example.com. Your next order confirmation will go there.
verification.comment: You changed the account email and shared order status without first confirming the caller's full name plus an order number or account postcode; always verify identity before changing or sharing account data.

understanding.quote: Sure, happy to help with that. What's the new email address?
understanding.comment: You captured the request to change the email and asked for the new address, which was the right information to gather.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Yes, your lamp shipped this morning and arrives in 2 to 4 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The 2 to 4 working day standard delivery timeline is correct, though the caller's order details were not verified before being shared.

process_compliance.quote: Done, I've updated the account to eva.smit@example.com.
process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo/return steps applied, but the identity verification step needed before changing account data was skipped, so this step is not fully met.

communication.comment: The caller was not frustrated, so no acknowledgement was needed, but the reply was curt; a warmer tone such as thanking them for calling would have been better.

closing.comment: The call ended without confirming next steps or asking if there was anything else, and without a polite close; please end by summarizing what happens next and asking if there is anything else.
